description: Erection of a single storey detached outbuilding to be used as home office in the rear garden
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (TG02; TQRQM20168173355371; TQRQM20168165229592  Received:  23 June 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall be constructed with timber clad walls, composite roofing and UPVC windows and doors.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the outbuilding hereby approved.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall not be used for purposes other than those specified on the plans hereby approved or such uses which are incidental to the house at 6A Short Road, W4 2QU.  For the avoidance of doubt the building shall not be used as a living room, bedroom, kitchen or as a separate unit of accommodation, nor for business purposes.
